title: app-host apps.json
description: The applications the app host runs, and their folders inside the apps root. How each one runs is in its own app.json.

name.description: Must equal the name in the application's app.json.

path.description: The application's folder, relative to the apps root (APPHOST_APPS_ROOT).

enabled.description: false keeps the entry but leaves the application alone: not started, not shown.
